subject: POC: Stellar Commerce - success criteria & risk tracker (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC next steps + success criteria (follow-up)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the call today. It was great to hear more about Stellar Commerce's goals for a search-and-recommendations POC. Per our conversation I pulled together the short summary and proposed next steps below so we have alignment before we kick off: 

Summary / success criteria (proposal)
- Serve product recommendations on PDP and category pages with >95% availability during 1k req/min synthetic load test.
- Recommendation relevance: judge via A/B onMerch ranking lift (target +6% CTR on recommended items vs baseline).
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency under 200ms for the tail of requests with 512-token contexts.
- Cost: token cost target <= $0.0006 per recommendation (benchmarking estimate).

POC scope & timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize test accounts, sample dataset, and env access.
- Week 1: model onboarding + integration (S3 sample feed -> Redwood endpoints) + smoke tests.
- Week 2: load tests, metrics collection, and relevance evaluation.
- Week 3: analyze results, mitigation plan for any blockers, and review session.

Ownership
- Redwood: Marissa (PM) / Marcus (AE) / Dylan (SE) for integration and tuning.
- Stellar: Alex (Product) / Priya (Engineering lead) — provide dataset, access, and success-headline metrics.

Immediate asks
1) Alex/Priya: confirm the dataset export (S3) and the engineers we should loop in for initial access (SSH/GCP IAM).
2) Both: confirm these proposed success criteria or flag adjustments.

I've attached a lightweight risk tracker and the POC scope doc. I propose a quick kickoff on Wednesday — does 10am PT work?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: poc_scope.pdf, stellar_poc_risk_tracker.xlsx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarcommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@stellarcommerce.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC next steps + success criteria (follow-up)

Thanks Marissa — this is super helpful. Quick answers and clarifications: 

- Dataset: we'll provide a 30-day product/behavior export to an S3 bucket. Priya will share the bucket name and role tomorrow.
- Success criteria: overall looks good. A few asks from our side: 
  * Can we include a qualitative evaluation (merch review) for top-10 recs on PDPs? We'll have 3 merch managers do blind scoring.
  * For latency, lower is better — would it be possible to aim for 150ms p95 if the model variant allows?

Blocked risks we need clarity on before kickoff:
1) Data access and PII: need confirmation of data handling and retention — SOC2 concern for infra team.
2) On-prem connectors: we may have a staging environment behind a firewall that requires a private deployment option. Is that something Redwood supports for a POC?
3) Fallback behavior: if recommendations fail, we need a defined fallback to existing rule-based recs.

We're OK with Wednesday 10am PT — Priya and I will join. Priya, can you confirm the S3 details and whether the staging env will require a tunnel?

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Senior Product Manager, Stellar Commerce
alex.johnson@stellarcommerce.com

Subject: Re: POC next steps + success criteria (internal)

Quick internal note before the kickoff:

- Data/PII: we'll provide a short SOC2 evidence summary and a data handling note for Priya. I can attach the SOC2 artifact and our retention policy. That should satisfy their infra/security team for initial staging.
- On-prem/staging tunnel: Redwood Private supports a temporary VPC peering + SSH tunnel for POC (we've done a few). However, that increases setup time by ~3 business days. Need to surface that to Stellar and decide if they want the staging tunnel now or just run tests against a sanitized S3 export.
- Fallback behavior: we can ship a simple HTTP gate that returns rule-based recs when the model returns an error. Dylan will own the gating scaffold and smoke tests.

I've started an internal risk tracker (attached) with initial mitigations. Recommend we bring Lauren in on the kickoff to cover success metrics instrumentation and evaluation plan.

Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC next steps + success criteria & risk tracker (kickoff materials)

Alex/Priya —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. I've attached an updated risk tracker (stellar_poc_risk_tracker.xlsx) and the POC scope (poc_scope.pdf) that incorporate Dylan's notes and the qualitative merch scoring. Summary of key kickoff points below: 

1) Data & Security
- Action: Priya to provide S3 bucket details + any staging access constraints by EOD Tue.
- Mitigation: Redwood to share SOC2 summary + data retention policy (Dylan will send).
- Escalation: If infra blocks access, Redwood sales_eng leadership (Marcus) to engage for executive approval.

2) Staging connectivity
- Option A: Use S3 export only (fastest) — recommended to get early signal.
- Option B: Temporary tunnel/VPC peering into staging (adds ~3 business days).
- Decision: Priya, please confirm which path you prefer in your reply.

3) Evaluation plan
- Qualitative: 3 merch managers will score top-10 recs on relevance (1–5).
- Quantitative: CTR lift and latency / availability metrics. Lauren will instrument and provide dashboard links.

4) Ownership & next steps
- Marissa: kickoff coordination + success criteria clarifications.
- Dylan: gating/fallback scaffold + SOC2 artifact.
- Lauren: evaluation dashboard and A/B hooks.
- Marcus: commercial lead and escalation contact.

Kickoff: Wed 12 Aug, 10:00am PT — calendar invite sent.

Thanks — attaching the two files again for convenience.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: stellar_poc_risk_tracker.xlsx, poc_scope.pdf
